separation_basis: Separate read-only sub-agent; did not implement or modify the reviewed implementation, schema, tests, example, or contract.

requirements: P01 task requirements and RCPT-01/RCPT-02/RCPT-03 acceptance cases
Duplicate JSON object members are rejected before schema validation or hash evaluation without echoing field names or values
Provenance-only full-plan/catalog hashes, task/case/global-boundary closure, exact case/assertion sets, evidence validation, and source/review snapshot binding
Historical P01-to-P00 context allowlist, manifest integrity, and known-legacy-only status
Recursive current dependencies and cycle rejection
Read-only stdout sidecar, no receipt command execution, and path purpose/scope/symlink/hardlink controls
No secret/company-document/web-body disclosure and legacy-byte preservation
